SPEC.context: The project currently has no mechanism for initializing collaborative workspaces. This feature implements the entry point for team sessions, allowing users to define a feature or topic and automatically provision a session, its associated data in Supabase, and a Realtime-synchronized UI. This is critical for establishing the team's shared workspace as envisioned in STRAT-0001.
api_contracts: POST /sessions, request body {"feature_name": "string"}, response 201 {"session_id": "uuid", "status": "open", "link": "/sessions/{session_id}", "canvas": {"quadrants": ["IS", "IS NOT", "DOES", "DOES NOT"]}}
data_models: supabase/migrations/0001_workspace.sql: workspaces, canvases, and quadrants tables
constraints: session_id must be a random UUIDv4
Realtime push to NiceGUI clients via WebSockets without polling

decisions.text: We will use UUIDv4 for session identification to ensure uniqueness and security for link-based access control.

sections.Architectural_Style: The system follows a reactive, event-driven architecture. The client-side UI (NiceGUI) interacts with a lightweight FastAPI controller that delegates session persistence to Supabase. Supabase acts as both the primary database and the real-time event bus, ensuring that changes to the quadrant state are propagated to all connected clients within the 2000ms latency requirement.
sections.Business_Goals: To provide a standardized, reliable, and real-time collaboration environment for team decision-making, specifically optimized for the rapid instantiation of workspace sessions.
sections.System_Decomposition: The system consists of the NiceGUI-based web application, a session management service, and the external Supabase platform. Communication is centered around the Supabase Realtime engine, which synchronizes state between the backend and all active clients.
sections.System_Mission: Quadra facilitates real-time team alignment by providing an ephemeral, highly responsive workspace where participants can co-create and manage quadrant-based decisions.

SPEC.What is the concrete feature name to use: Workspace and Realtime Canvas Initialization (Intent 1 of quadra_intents.md). Intents 2 to 4 (card operations, session closure and agent retrieval, Markdown export) are out of scope for this spec.
SPEC.Which C4 element IDs are directly impact: quadra-app: the NiceGUI app container (UI served on FastAPI). session-service: the Python module that creates the session and its canvas in Supabase. supabase: external system, Supabase PostgreSQL plus Realtime.
SPEC.What is the exact API contract for creat: POST /sessions, a FastAPI route inside the NiceGUI app; there is no page for creating sessions. Request body: {"feature_name": "<non-empty string>"}. No authentication: access is link-based. Success: 201 with {"session_id": "<uuid>", "status": "open", "link": "/sessions/{session_id}", "canvas": {"quadrants": ["IS", "IS NOT", "DOES", "DOES NOT"]}}. A missing or empty feature_name returns 422 and creates nothing. The link opens the NiceGUI page /sessions/{session_id}, which shows the canvas and receives Realtime updates; an unknown session_id shows "Session not found". The agent harness endpoint belongs to Intent 3 and is out of scope.
SPEC.What are the names and locations (file p: src/quadra/sessions.py: create_session(feature_name) -> Session and a Session dataclass (session_id, feature_name, status, created_at, quadrants). src/quadra/api.py: Pydantic models SessionCreateRequest and SessionCreateResponse and the POST /sessions route. src/quadra/app.py: the NiceGUI canvas page. No separate JSON schema files: FastAPI generates the OpenAPI schema from the Pydantic models. Supabase tables workspaces (session_id, feature_name, status, created_at), canvases and quadrants, defined in supabase/migrations/0001_workspace.sql.
SPEC.Does this feature depend on any external: Supabase (PostgreSQL and Realtime) through supabase-py, configured with SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_KEY read from the environment. The UI framework is NiceGUI. Nothing else.
SPEC.Are there any specific constraints that: Session creation completes in under 2 seconds (STRAT-0001 goal). session_id is a random UUIDv4, since the link is the only access control. feature_name must be non-empty. When a session is created or modified, the Supabase Realtime event is pushed to every connected client through NiceGUI's websocket within the < 2000ms target of STRAT-0001, with no polling (polling is STRAT-0001's rejected alternative). No rate limiting and no idempotency handling.
SPEC.Are there any existing behaviors or syst: None: greenfield project. The repository only contains an empty src/quadra package.
